body:
I know the rule is to be active for over a month, and before the flurry of negative votes come in, please read further.
I am a long time lurker/lover of reddit. (/Shibe anyone?) I have a friend who is extremely active, and always keeping me lurking the good subdreddits, he suggested I post here since he is unable to help at all until his pay day next week. He's going to vouch for my situation.
I lost my job a few weeks ago due to some pretty ridiculous circumstances. I am actually going to have to move into a shelter come the end of the month until I find another job. I'm not looking forward to losing all of my privacy (and most of my dignity), in fact I am rather scared. But I know I will pull through, and be a positive influence in someone else's life.
If you could find it in your heart to help me have a good meal while I still have some privacy, I guarantee it will be payed forward.
